task: T05 of the SmartTube AI-subtitle plan: the AiSubtitleController owns one session and must block every stale write-back. Judge these four claims about invalidation order, idempotence, clearing and refusal before the scheduler and player wiring build on them.

checks.claim: Every session change invalidates the identity before cancelling in-flight work, so a callback racing with the cancel already fails the freshness check.
Re-selecting the same source keeps the existing session instead of rebuilding it, so a brief audio/video track change cannot cause a duplicate translation.
A seek, subtitles-off, AI-off or release makes every earlier result unusable, and a result arriving without a selected source is refused as well.
Changing the display mode never invalidates the session, and enabling AI later re-applies the stored mode without a new request.
